summary: GrowInLove is an ICP canister + React SPA for couples to strengthen their relationship via daily ritual prompts, partner pairing, shared ritual history (“Memories”), photo sharing, and a Love Languages quiz with partner synchronization. The frontend uses Internet Identity for authentication, React Query for canister IO (including polling-based partner sync), and a tab-based UI (Home/Insights/Memories/Activities/Us). The backend enforces role-based access control (guest/user/admin), mutual partner authorization, couple-scoped storage keyed by a canonical coupleId, and supports ritual entries merged per day with canonical partner completion status. Insights and milestone badges are wired end-to-end in the UI but currently backed by stubbed analytics responses in the canister.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication provider (login/logout + persisted identity restore)
existing_features.description: Provides a React context for Internet Identity authentication using @dfinity/auth-client. Restores an authenticated delegation on reload, supports login/logout, and exposes status flags for UI gating.

existing_features.title: Identity-bound canister actor creation with access-control initialization
existing_features.description: Creates an anonymous actor when unauthenticated and an identity-bound actor when authenticated. On authenticated actor creation, initializes backend access control using a secret token sourced from the URL hash/sessionStorage. Invalidates and refetches non-actor queries when the actor changes.

existing_features.title: Role-based access control (guest/user/admin) with admin bootstrap and role assignment
existing_features.description: Backend maintains principal→role mapping; initializes roles using CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN plus a caller-provided secret, exposes caller role/admin queries, and supports admin-only role assignment. Frontend can query admin status for gating/overrides.

existing_features.title: User profile onboarding and management
existing_features.description: Users initialize a profile (name). Frontend shows a dedicated ProfileSetup flow if authenticated but profile is missing, and supports saving profile updates. Backend prevents direct modification of role/isFirstUser/partnerId through profile saving.

existing_features.title: Partner pairing via 6-digit code (generate/check/complete) with share/copy UX
existing_features.description: Implements pairing code creation and completion; backend links two profiles by setting partnerId for both and removes the used code mapping. Frontend supports generating a code, copying it, sharing a link, entering a partner code, and displaying connection state.

existing_features.title: One-time post-pairing highlight and navigation shortcuts from Us tab
existing_features.description: After pairing completes, a localStorage flag triggers a one-time highlight animation on the “Our Love Languages” card. The Us tab provides SPA navigation callbacks to Love Languages and to Insights with sessionStorage-based auto-scroll to the harmony section.

existing_features.title: Daily ritual prompt initialization and deterministic daily selection
existing_features.description: Backend lazily initializes a fixed prompt set and returns the day’s prompt deterministically using the day-number modulo the prompt count. Frontend fetches the prompt via React Query and displays a love-language themed hero card.

existing_features.title: Ritual response submission with optional text, emoji, and photo
existing_features.description: Users submit daily ritual responses with optional text/emoji/photoId. Frontend manages form state, supports random emoji selection, photo selection/preview/removal, and uploads the photo first when needed before submitting the ritual response.

existing_features.title: Canonical partner completion attribution and polling-based ritual sync
existing_features.description: Backend returns ritual completion status with canonical partnerA/partnerB ordering derived from principal text ordering. Frontend computes caller vs partner completion by comparing the authenticated principal to partnerA/partnerB and polls every 5s for updates, displaying Waiting/Both Completed states.

existing_features.title: Ritual completion celebration animation
existing_features.description: Shows a floating-hearts overlay when both partners complete a ritual, triggered by completion state transitions on Home.

existing_features.title: Multi-day ritual history storage, merging, and retrieval (limit + newest-first)
existing_features.description: Backend stores one ritual entry per day per couple and merges same-day partner submissions into a single entry containing per-user responses. getRitualHistory(limit) returns entries sorted newest-first and respects the limit; frontend additionally performs defensive sorting.

existing_features.title: Ritual history and Memories UI with modal/expand drill-in and inline photo rendering
existing_features.description: Home shows a ritual history list with a modal to view full prompt and both partners’ responses. Memories provides a scrapbook view with expand/collapse per entry and progressive loading by increasing the getRitualHistory(limit) parameter. Both render linked photos inline by fetching photoId.

existing_features.title: Shared photo upload/storage/retrieval/listing/deletion with partner/admin access
existing_features.description: Backend stores photo blobs with owner and timestamp and authorizes access for owner, mutual partner, or admin. Frontend uploads photos as ExternalBlob, fetches photos by id, lists photos by user, and supports deletion (owner/admin).

existing_features.title: Love Languages quiz UI with persistence, sharing, reset/retake, and sync UX
existing_features.description: Implements a 7-question quiz, computes rankings, saves results to the backend, auto-loads saved results on mount, supports sharing via Web Share/clipboard, and supports caller-only retake/reset with confirmation. Includes sync banners and retry UI for error cases.

existing_features.title: Combined quiz synchronization state with polling and overlap-based harmony score
existing_features.description: Backend returns both partners’ quiz completion flags and results for paired users. Frontend polls every 5s and uses the combined state to show waiting/synced states and compute a top-3 overlap “harmony score” for display.

existing_features.title: Partner quiz state endpoint with authorization and defensive client fallback
existing_features.description: Backend provides an endpoint to retrieve a partner’s quiz completion/results with authorization (mutual pairing or admin; cannot query self). Frontend derives partnerId from the caller profile, polls for completion, and falls back safely if the endpoint fails.

existing_features.title: Insights dashboard UI wired to backend insights/badges with truthfulness gates
existing_features.description: Frontend renders an insights dashboard using getInsightsData/getBadgeMilestones: streak overview, 7-day history built from backend trend arrays, harmony breakdown & trend card with data-availability gating, milestone badge progress, and badge-unlock celebration overlay. Quiz alignment summary is shown only when both partners completed the quiz.

existing_features.title: Activities hub with spin wheel and streak-unlocked love-language activity packs (admin override)
existing_features.description: Activities page includes a Love Challenges placeholder and Reward Visuals placeholder, a spin wheel with smooth easing and daily localStorage persistence (weighted by quiz results when available), and love-language activity packs that unlock based on streak (with admin override and shared-language highlighting).

existing_features.title: Secure secret handling via URL hash + sessionStorage + URL cleanup
existing_features.description: Extracts sensitive parameters (e.g., caffeineAdminToken) from the URL hash, stores them in sessionStorage, and removes them from the address bar via history.replaceState to reduce leakage.

existing_features.title: Manual QA acceptance checklist for core flows and synchronization
existing_features.description: Repository includes a comprehensive manual QA checklist covering pairing, ritual submissions (text/emoji/photo), canonical completion attribution, multi-day ritual history behavior, quiz synchronization, and insights determinism expectations.

architectural_notes: Frontend is a tab-based React SPA (no react-router) with navigation handled via local state (App.tsx) and a fixed BottomNav.
Canister communication is centralized in frontend React Query hooks (useQueries.ts) with targeted cache invalidation after mutations and polling (e.g., ritual status, quiz sync, insights/badges).
Authentication uses Internet Identity via @dfinity/auth-client; identities are restored on mount and exposed through a React context provider.
Backend actor composes cross-cutting functionality via Motoko mixins (authorization and blob-storage maintenance).
Role-based authorization is enforced on most backend methods via AccessControl.hasPermission, with admin bootstrapped using an env var token (CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN) plus a caller-provided secret.
Couple-scoped isolation is implemented via a canonical coupleId derived from sorted principal text; backend checks mutual pairing before allowing couple reads/writes.
Daily ritual prompts are lazily initialized on first use and selected deterministically using a day-number modulo prompt count.
Ritual entries are stored per-couple and per-day; same-day submissions are merged into one entry containing per-user responses.
Frontend uses Tailwind + shadcn-ui, OKLCH theme tokens, and custom animations (floating-heart celebration overlays, badge unlock overlay, one-time highlight after pairing).
Client persistence is used for UX-only state (localStorage: daily spin result, post-pairing highlight; sessionStorage: admin token, Insights auto-scroll flag).
known_issues: Backend getInsightsData() currently returns placeholder zeros/empty arrays for streak/harmony/trends/challenges; the Insights UI will therefore show mostly empty/zero analytics despite being “truthful”.
Backend getBadgeMilestones() always returns default milestone progress (all false) regardless of actual streak/harmony, so badges do not unlock based on real data.

Backend getStreakData() logic appears incorrect/incomplete (does not clearly validate “both partners completed per day”, has unused/odd partner variables), so any future use may be unreliable without fixes.
Prompt listing endpoints fetchPrompts()/getPromptsByLoveLanguage() do not call internalInitPrompts(); they may return empty until another call (e.g., getDailyRitual) initializes prompts.
Frontend useArePromptsInitialized() is a stub that always returns true (backend method not implemented), which can mask real prompt initialization problems.
Pairing codes have no expiration/TTL enforcement despite UX messaging implying expiry (“Invalid or expired pairing code”).
Blob-storage maintenance endpoint _caffeineStorageUpdateGatewayPrincipals() has no authorization check, allowing any caller to refresh the gateway principal list.
Environment variable typo: Storage.getCashierPrincipal reads CAFFFEINE_STORAGE_CASHIER_PRINCIPAL (triple “F”); misconfiguration will trap at runtime.
Storage.refillCashier uses Nat.sub(currentBalance, reservedCycles) which can trap if the canister balance is below the reserved amount.
React Query is provided twice (QueryClientProvider in frontend/src/main.tsx and again in frontend/src/App.tsx), creating redundant clients and potential confusion/inconsistent cache usage.
